items.title: Rusty Dedrick interviewed by Monk Rowe, Ellenville, New York, June 23, 1998
items.q: Like we had Irving Fazola and Nick Fatool and later Irv —

ctx.x: In fact I was going to ask you what the average salary of a sideman was in those years.

With Red it was like a low figure and you were lucky to get it. And not that he — it was a financial problem that he could not cope with. That was an old trick, and I should not take too much time on it, but if you worked a week here and then had two days off, they’d change the payday to conform to the next — Now after, with Claude, he had more backing and everything and that was not it. But the salary pre-war I would say ran like $150, something like that a week. Like we had Irving Fazola and Nick Fatool and…
